user.title: Set up Skylight Family
user.description: Coordinates family members with their calendars and to-do lists, for Skylight HA to read. Add members and task presets afterward from this integration's page.

data.reset_time: Daily reset time (clears completed items and applies today's presets)

data_description.panel_admin_only: When off, any Home Assistant user can see the Skylight panel in the sidebar and change routines and presets from it.

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Pushes a preset's to-do items onto one or more Skylight Family members' to-do lists right now, independent of the daily schedule.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The exact name of an existing Skylight Family preset, e.g. "Toddler".

set_star.name: Set star
set_star.description: Awards or revokes a day's star for one or more Skylight Family members, overriding whether their chores were actually finished.

star.name: Star
star.description: On to award the star, off to revoke it. Leave it unset to remove the manual override and go back to deciding the day from whether the chores got done.

date.name: Date
date.description: Which day to change. Defaults to today.

add_money.name: Add money entry
add_money.description: Records a deposit or an expense on a Skylight Family member's short-term or long-term account.

kind.name: Type
kind.description: Deposit adds to the balance, expense takes away, transfer moves between the two accounts.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day it happened. Defaults to today. Back-dating is allowed and recalculates any interest earned since.

to_account.name: Transfer to
to_account.description: For a transfer only: the account the money moves into.
